text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To emotionally support her in critical 
moments, the Trainer sought to build a 
relationship of trust with Mejiro Ramonu, 
and paid a visit to the Mejiro Estate with 
that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You learn why Mejiro Ramonu developed such 
an obsession with racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In her childhood, she was unable to run 
due to instability in her legs. Mejiro 
Ramonu overcame that barrier, allowing her 
talent to truly blossom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally, she receives advice from Mejiro 
Bright: if she wishes to build mutual 
trust, she should ask what she wants to 
know most...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu remains an utter mystery. 
The Trainer is left unable to answer what 
they truly want to know about her.
